context: area: src/upgrade_portal/upgrade/options.py compatibility and target validation
area: src/upgrade_portal/app/routes/upgrade.py options view and save
constraint: never select an unavailable version or submit during validation
intent: Provide safe per-device-type upgrade target defaults while preserving explicit operator confirmation.
expectations: Do not change upgrade execution, confirmation wording, or post-upgrade verification.
Do not add per-device or per-model override settings.
Do not invent versions absent from returned availability data.
approach: Add a typed selector that derives one common compatible target for each device type from returned availability data. Render independent type controls, validate current availability on save, and preserve the existing CONFIRM-only start boundary.

decisions.decision: Use returned model availability as the only target source
decisions.why: It proves current device support and prevents invented versions.
Every eligible device of a type must offer a selected target.

decisions.decision: Validate against a current save-time read
decisions.why: Page data can become stale or be tampered with.

decisions.decision: Keep individual saved targets and the confirmation boundary
decisions.why: The existing body and start gate preserve safe no-submit behavior.
decisions.rejected: A new type-target API or save-time upgrade

decisions.decision: Use the three approved type-specific environment variables
decisions.why: Each override stays isolated and must match a compatible returned candidate.
decisions.rejected: A global, per-device, or per-model override
